[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Andalou Naturals - biodegradable, sulfate-free, non-GMO, cruelty-free shampoo.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional tips for using biodegradable products:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Check ingredients and look for certifications like EPA Safer Choice.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Use a portable washing station or biodegradable soap dispenser.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Be mindful of the amount of soap or shampoo used.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Consider using a refillable container for soap or shampoo.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Reminder to follow Leave No Trace principles and dispose of waste properly.
